notes: Main disagreements: (1) unit boundaries: coders split or joined multi-rule sentences differently (A split data-handling and privacy sentences; B joined study-aid/brainstorming, compliance/variation and institutional-tools/never-input-confidential into one policy), resolved by keeping one rule per unit and counting the extra piece as a kept single-coder unit. (2) phase: stage-vs-general for principles and duties (resolved by whether the rule is tied to a point in the work). (3) modality: source wording decides (should/may/must; "avoid" = should-not; AI Assessment Scale level descriptions "may be used" = may). (4) policy_type: pointer to CETL (UNCOVERED), AI Assessment Scale levels (P05 not P16/P15), detector statements (P39), administrative planning rules (P76 not P73/P53), critique-of-AI-output use (UNCOVERED). (5) unit_stance: neutral for procedures and advice, require for must-duties (following the convention in agreed pairs), restrict for enforcement. Actor all vs admin for institution-wide principles resolved to all. One link heading (Copyleaks) dropped; one split clause (external legal frameworks) merged into its sentence. All 3 document-level stances agreed. Alignment was repaired by hand where the overlap-based first pass paired different rules from the same sentence (3 pairs changed).
